description: Given a project idea (vague is fine), return 3-5 hardware proposals with 'why this fits', hack difficulty, brick risk (with safety rule applied), firmware links, community size, and a suggested eBay search query string. Compose with ebay-mcp at the host level for live listings.

budget_usd.description: Optional budget in USD. Affects eBay query suggestions.

idea.description: Project idea, free-form. Vague is OK; the agent will use creativity.
